Spellcasting points and Inventory. Seija has a total of 12 spell points that can be consumed. Long rest restores all spell points, a short rest restores 3 spell points.
She has a DC of 16 and a +8 to spell hits

additionalAbilities.name: Amanojaku Nature
additionalAbilities.description:
Seija is contrary by nature. Once per turn, whenever a creature would gain advantage on an attack roll against her, that creature has disadvantage instead. The effect is immediately triggered when conditions are met. She cannot use this ability again until the start of her next turn.

Avrae: Run this helper after resolving the eligible trigger manually. The used marker expires at the start of her next turn; it does not enforce or intercept attack rolls.

{"_v":2,"name":"Amanojaku Nature","automation":[{"type":"text","text":"Manual trigger only: change the eligible incoming attack from advantage to disadvantage. If already rolled, reroll ONLY its attack die with the correct total bonus; do not execute its damage twice. Track eligibility and any result corrections yourself."},{"type":"target","target":"self","effects":[{"type":"ieffect2","name":"Amanojaku Nature used","desc":"Reminder: unavailable until the start of Seija's next turn. This does not intercept or modify incoming attacks.","stacking":false,"duration":1}]}]}

additionalAbilities.name: Turnabout "Reverse Hierarchy"
additionalAbilities.description:
After the initiative order is decided, Seija can designated two creatures she can see within 120ft, and have their initiatives swapped. Creatures with higher CR than her are unaffected by this ability She can use this ability equal to her Proficiency Bonus.

Avrae: Manual swap and eligibility checks. This helper only displays instructions; it neither rolls initiative again nor changes it.

{"_v":2,"name":"Reverse Hierarchy","automation":[{"type":"text","text":"Manual initiative swap. Choose exactly two visible creatures within 120 ft whose CR does not exceed Seija's CR 8. Verify their LIVE initiatives. In Aina use Follow-up / uses > Swap initiative; otherwise apply the two verified initiative adjustments manually. No swap is performed by this helper. Track 3 uses; the source does not specify their recharge."}]}

additionalAbilities.name: Reverse Sign "Danmaku Through the Looking-Glass"
additionalAbilities.description:
On her turn, Seija can lower the spell save DC of a creature she see within 60 ft by 4. The effect lasts for 5 minutes or until used. She can use this ability equal to her Proficiency Bonus.

Avrae: Select the affected combatant. This is a timed reminder: add -dc -4 to its affected spell command, then click Spell used. Non-spell DCs are unchanged; uses and eligibility are manual.

{"_v":2,"name":"Looking-Glass","automation":[{"type":"target","target":"each","effects":[{"type":"ieffect2","name":"Looking-Glass - {{caster.name}}","desc":"Spell save DC is reduced by 4 for 5 minutes or until used. SPELLS ONLY. Add -dc -4 to the affected spell command; this marker has no universal dc_bonus. After the affected spell, click Spell used. Track Seija's 3 uses manually.","stacking":false,"duration":50,"buttons":[{"label":"Spell used","automation":[{"type":"text","text":"Confirm that the affected spell used its DC reduced by 4. Other ability DCs were not reduced."},{"type":"remove_ieffect"}]}]}]}]}

actions.name: Forceful Burst
actions.description:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 120/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8) force damage. If you roll an 8 on a d8 for this spell, you can roll another d8, and add it to the damage. When you cast this spell, the maximum number of these d8s you can add to the spell’s damage equals your spellcasting ability modifier.

Avrae: Base attack and 2d8 damage are automated. Extra dice use the separate Extra d8 utility and manual cap/damage tracking. The original printed average of 11 is retained; automation follows the stated 2d8, whose average is 9.

[{"_v":2,"name":"Forceful Burst","automation":[{"type":"target","target":"each","effects":[{"type":"attack","attackBonus":"8","hit":[{"type":"damage","damage":"2d8[force]"},{"type":"text","text":"For each eligible damage d8 showing 8, you may roll one additional d8. Resolve these explicitly, at most 5 additional dice in total for this casting. Additional dice showing 8 can trigger another die within that cap. reactions.name: Reverse Sign "Evil in the Mirror"
reactions.description:
When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you succeeds an ability check or a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to reduce a bonus to the roll, potentially causing it to fail. The bonus equals your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1). You can take this Reaction a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest or half when you finish a Short Rest (rounded up).

Avrae: Explicit after-roll correction. This helper does not change another roll, subtract HP, spend a reaction, or manage uses automatically.

{"_v":2,"name":"Evil in the Mirror","automation":[{"type":"text","text":"Manual reaction after an eligible successful ability check or saving throw within 30 ft. Subtract 5 from its EXISTING total and compare against the original DC; do not reroll by default. Aina's Adjust a recorded total tool can assist. Correct already-applied consequences manually. Uses: 5; long rest restores all; resolve the original short-rest half-recovery rule, rounded up, manually. No universal save/check penalty is applied."}]}

legendaryActions.name: Reverse Sign "This Side Down" (1 points)
legendaryActions.description:
(Action; 1 spell point plus extra points) Seija inverts gravity in a 20-foot cube she can see within 60 ft. Targets make a DC 16 Strength save. Failure: flung 30 feet, immediately fall for 4d8 bludgeoning damage, become prone, and have movement 0 on their next turn. Success: half damage, no prone or movement restriction. Each extra spell point adds 15 feet of height, 2d8 damage, and +1 DC.

Target STR save DC 16; half damage on success.
Damage: 4d8 bludgeoning; +2d8 per extra step.
Effect: Prone; indefinite. Prone. Stand up costs half your speed; requires available movement.
Effect: Restricted movement; 1 rounds. Movement 0 on your next turn.
Upcast: 0 to 11 extra steps; track the resource cost manually.

legendaryActions.name: Reverse Sign "Overturning All Under Heaven" (1 point)
legendaryActions.description:
(Bonus Action) Seija conjures a 30ft radius cylinder at a point she can see within 120ft. All creatures inside that sphere have their fate reversed. The first time they roll for a D20 Test, the outcome becomes reversed, turning a fail into a success and vice versa. Creatures affected by this cannot forcefully fail a save.

Avrae: Apply the next-d20 reminder to selected targets. Resolve the reversed outcome yourself, then click D20 resolved.

The creature cannot voluntarily fail a save while affected. Resolve that outcome and already-applied consequences manually, then click D20 resolved. This reminder does not intercept rolls or change their numerical totals.","stacking":false,"buttons":[{"label":"D20 resolved","automation":[{"type":"text","text":"Confirm that the first eligible d20 Test was resolved with success/failure reversed and any consequences corrected. (Action) (Concentration) You conjure a hail of needle in a 10-foot Cube within 60ft. Each creature in that area takes 4d8 Piercing damage. Each creature hit must then make a DC 16 constitution saving throw or become inflicted with bleeding. At the start its turn, they take 2d8 necrotic damage, at the end of the its turn the target repeats the save, ending the effect on a success. On your later turns, you can take a Magic action to conjure a hail of needle again. The damage increases by 2d8 per stage for each additional spell point consumed.

Avrae: Initial cast: -choice N gives extra points. Piercing damage happens before the save. Bleeding has start-damage/end-save buttons linked to Seija's concentration.
